pages.title: Declare One
pages.text:
Type /path to see them. Type /path forge - or art, salvage, blade, crown, wall - to walk one.

Once declared, hostile kills pay you in that path's materials. Kills near the surface pay little. Kills on the Sealed Floor pay properly.

pages.title: Why Choose
pages.text:
Each path is strong at something and genuinely weak at something else. With four of you, weakness is what makes the others worth talking to.

You are not locked in. But a group where everyone walks the same path is a group doing one thing slowly.
